title: Fixes only work for 1-2 clients, not all 188
what_was_done: The fix-notes system (/api/fix-notes/test/:id) tests only a sample of 10 fiscalIds for 'cliente' type and 20 lines for 'cdr' type. It doesn't run against all 188 clients.
what_still_needs_to_be_done: Implement bulk testing across ALL 188 clients. The test endpoint should: (1) iterate all customers from API, (2) run each fix against every client, (3) report pass/fail per client, (4) show aggregate statistics. Current test only samples a small subset (10/188).

title: Repeated bug reports — same bugs reported 3-4 times without being fixed
what_was_done: Fix-notes system has 'report fail' endpoint and re-opens bugs when user clicks '❌ Sigue fallando'. The MEMORIA_ERRORES.md and AGENTS.md document lessons learned.
what_still_needs_to_be_done: (1) Implement automatic re-opening of a fix-note when regression is detected in a new test run. (2) Add root cause analysis field to each fix-note so the same bug type doesn't recur. (3) Prevent marking as 'fixed' unless test passes for >95% of clients.

title: CodeOpen features don't actually work (AUTO mode, voice selector, profile pics)
what_was_done: UI elements exist in codeopen.ejs: AUTO toggle button (line 1253), voice selector dropdown (line 1474), profile pic loading (lines 1221-1241), backend endpoint /whatsapp/profile-pic/:jid (routes/codeopen.js:1592). AUTO mode has server-side auto-process endpoint (routes/codeopen.js:964).

(3) Profile pics: wa-baileys.js fetches profilePictureUrl but may fail for users without profile pics, needs better fallback and caching.

title: Comprobar button hangs on 'Probando...' indefinitely
what_was_done: Button triggers POST /api/fix-notes/test/:id (fix-notes.ejs:103-128, routes/fix-notes.js:83-153). Frontend shows spinner while waiting.
what_still_needs_to_be_done: The test endpoint has no timeout for API calls — if Likes API is slow/unreachable, the request hangs forever. Add: (1) per-request timeout (e.g., 15s), (2) overall request timeout, (3) better frontend feedback (show 'timeout' message), (4) implement AbortController in fetch call, (5) add fallback with cached data when API times out.

title: Orders show '-' for products
what_was_done: Order views (orders/list.ejs, orders/view.ejs, altas/index.ejs) use pattern: `orden.producto || '-'`. If `producto` field is empty/null in DB, dash appears.
what_still_needs_to_be_done: (1) Investigate why product data is missing in orders — likely the product name isn't being captured during order creation (views/orders/create.ejs uses free-text input, altas/index.ejs may not map Likes product ID to name correctly). (2) Add automatic product name resolution: when an order has a likes_product_id but no producto name, fetch from API/products table and backfill. (3) Show 'Sin especificar' instead of '-' for better UX. (4) Add DB migration to backfill existing orders.

title: Contracts S3 don't show real signatures
what_was_done: Proxy endpoint /clientes/contrato/s3/:orderId (routes/clients.js:1267-1338) tries multiple Likes API endpoints to find signed contract URL (draft-order-v2, customer documentation). Falls back through 4 strategies.
what_still_needs_to_be_done: (1) The proxy only returns whatever URL it finds — if Likes API doesn't return a signed PDF, user sees 'Contrato no disponible'. (2) No visual indicator of signature status before clicking. (3) KYC flow generates a PNG of the signed contract (routes/kyc.js:269) but this PNG may not have real signature — just a screenshot of the signing UI. (4) Add pre-check: call a lightweight endpoint to verify if signed PDF exists before showing download button. (5) Add alternative: show contract HTML/image when PDF unavailable.

title: All TTS (text-to-speech) voices sound the same
what_was_done: TTS system in services/transcription.js has 3 tiers: (1) AssemblyAI (requires key), (2) OpenRouter (requires key + model support), (3) Google TTS (free, always works as fallback). Voice selector dropdown exists in codeopen.ejs:1474 with options: Echo, Fable, Onyx, Nova.
what_still_needs_to_be_done: (1) Google TTS (the actual working fallback) does NOT support different voices — it only changes language (tl=es) and speed. All voice options map to same Google TTS endpoint. (2) AssemblyAI TTS needs VALID ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY configured in env. (3) OpenRouter TTS needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY and uses openai/tts-1 model which supports: alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, shimmer — but may not be enabled on the user's OpenRouter account. (4) Fix: either get AssemblyAI working with proper voice IDs, or remove voice selector and use single voice, or implement local TTS.
